title: tooltip: PR review flags genuinely-missing tooltips instead of deferring to AA0218
summary: PR review now independently flags genuinely missing tooltips on page fields instead of deferring to compiler analyzer AA0218, which can be disabled or downgraded in team rulesets.
key_points: Bound fields whose source field also lacks a ToolTip are now flagged as medium
Unbound controls without a ToolTip are now flagged as medium
Bound fields inheriting a ToolTip from the source field are still not flagged
Notes that AA0218 severity is set per app and is often downgraded or disabled
Anti-pattern now covers both over-flagging inherited fields and staying silent on real gaps
quote: PR review is the last line of defence.
